note: SEND MESSAGE AND GREETINGS. Channels name the employee column that holds the address; a recipient with no address on that channel is reported, not silently dropped. No transport is configured in this build: a send QUEUES one row per recipient and channel in messages_log with status 'queued', and the screen says so. Greeting templates are rendered by the letter engine ({{field}}, {{field|date}}, {{field|upper}}); a placeholder that resolves to nothing refuses the greeting rather than sending a blank.

birthday.subject: Happy birthday, {{name}}!
birthday.message:
Dear {{name}},

Wishing you a very happy birthday from all of us at {{company}}. May the year ahead bring you health, happiness and success.

Warm regards,
{{company}}

anniversary.subject: Happy work anniversary, {{name}}!
anniversary.message:
Dear {{name}},

Congratulations on completing {{years}} year(s) with {{company}} today. Thank you for your commitment and contribution.

Warm regards,
{{company}}
